name: Custom Entity Id
description: Lets editors set a custom entity ID on the entity-create page.
project_description:
This module allows site builders to create entity with their custom entity id. If the entity with given id is already exist a message will occur that "Entity id already exists".

 USE CASE

----------

 1. In case when you write any business logic on the basis of entity id you can use this module.

2. When you transfer data from one instance to another you can set id according your choice.

3. You can theme by creating templates of specific entity id.

 REQUIREMENTS

------------

 There is no requirement.

 CONFIGURATION

-------------

 There is configuration, pls configure first so custom entity id field can appear on entity form.
